_note: Oldest-end sweep batch 88: 9-11 June 2026. Model claude-opus-5, prompt v1.

mentions.claim_text: He says there are going to be things happening with them going in with Russia and joining in on the fight to help and fund them, that it will escalate even further and this thing got out of control, that he was then shown Israel and Iran and other countries all coming against Israel, and dates the first time he saw it to July 1st 2023.
mentions.quote: other other countries were all coming against Israel
mentions.falsify_match: A 1 July 2023 recording carrying this before the regional war began.
mentions.falsify_miss: No such recording, or it postdates events. The date is precise and worth pinning; 2023 predates this corpus, so it would have to be checked against the channel's own back catalogue.

mentions.claim_text: He gives all glory to God and says this is the urgency of the hour of praying and why they are there, that they must pray, points to them breaking dirt and planting trees together, and says he said they will have a meeting, that it is in the video, dated January 4th.
mentions.quote: I said they will have a meeting. It's in the video
mentions.falsify_match: The 4 January recording predating the meeting.
mentions.falsify_miss: It postdates it. He points to the video himself, which is the right way to make the claim, and it is checkable inside this corpus. Breaking dirt and planting trees together is a ceremonial photo opportunity, so what is confirmed is that a meeting happened, not what was agreed.

mentions.claim_text: He says it was against the United States and that he saw a secret Pearl Harbor attack coming against Hawaii, that there are many things he has seen but this bothered him, and that after his son asked whether he remembered the word he said he did not because they pray so much, then his son played it back and it all flashed back on him.
mentions.quote: I saw a secret Pearl Harbor attack coming against Hawaii
mentions.falsify_miss: None on a date, since none is given. He states plainly that he did not remember the word until it was played back to him, which is worth recording about how this archive is used.

mentions.claim_text: He says this is why the elections in November are so vital, that if they do not maintain the House and the Senate he is in trouble and the Lord said it, that he saw them losing the Senate and keeping the House, that he saw them losing the Senate by three seats, that he keeps praying over those three seats that they will not flip Democrat and for a fair election, and that they must get out and vote.
mentions.quote: I saw us losing the Senate by three seats
mentions.falsify_match: The Senate changing hands on exactly three seats while the House holds.
mentions.falsify_miss: Any other split. A number and a direction on a fixed date, which makes it the most scoreable political claim in the corpus. Note the escape written into the same sentence: he is praying the three seats will not flip, so a hold can be credited to prayer.

mentions.claim_text: He says he saw weapons being used again on Israel in the days ahead and that an attack worse than October the 7th is coming at night, that people ask whether he can stop it, that every single vision he has had is that it happens, that they pray over it for the protection of these people, and asks how many days prior they saw about October the 7th.
mentions.quote: An attack worse than October the 7th is coming at night
mentions.falsify_match: A night attack on Israel exceeding October 7th.
mentions.falsify_miss: None on a date. The important admission is his own: every single vision he has had is that it happens. That says prayer has not averted any of them, which cuts against the conditionality attached to almost every claim in this corpus.

mentions.claim_text: He says he knows they can stop some things but the Lord said you will not stop everything and some things will happen, that he is not trying to be doom and gloom but to be realistic, that some things are not stopped, that they prayed over the October the 7th attack for months prior, and that he said something major was about to happen in Israel and they can go back and watch the videos.
mentions.quote: the Lord said you will not stop everything. Some things will happen
mentions.falsify_miss: n/a. Some things are stopped and some are not covers every outcome in advance, and it is stated as doctrine rather than left implicit. Set beside his admission a moment earlier that every vision he has had came to pass, the two do not sit easily together.

mentions.claim_text: He says he calls it the storm and it would be the summer of 2028, that concerning the summer of 2028 there is a black upon the land and a darkness upon the buildings and he saw something dark, asks how many times he has talked about the plague, and says he saw forced vaccinations and another thing like COVID but worse, and a planned event trying to take place.
mentions.quote: So it would be summer of 2028. Summer of 2028, a storm
mentions.falsify_match: A pandemic worse than COVID with mandatory vaccination in summer 2028.
mentions.falsify_miss: It does not occur in that window. A named season and year plus a stated policy consequence, which makes this scoreable. It also sits against the plague timings already on file, which run from late 2027 through to 2030.

mentions.claim_text: He says he is in the month of June of 2028, that he sees what is on the news and can see all that is going on.
mentions.quote: I'm in the month of June of 2028
mentions.falsify_match: Something identifiable in the June 2028 news.
mentions.falsify_miss: None. He says he can see all that is going on and then reports none of it, so the passage narrows the date without adding any content to test.

mentions.claim_text: He says it is so real and the spirit realm is more real and more tangible than the natural, that you can tap into it and see over and see things to come, that he is seeing into June two years from now, that it has been on his heart strongly, and that he is praying over President Trump and his legacy, over the ballroom, and over these attacks that are coming.
mentions.quote: Praying over President Trump, his legacy. Praying over the the ballroom
mentions.falsify_match: The legacy and the ballroom turning out as described.
mentions.falsify_miss: None here. The passage restates the ballroom and legacy material without adding a test, though it confirms the June 2028 horizon he keeps returning to.

mentions.claim_text: He says he saw it on the schedule and that this is just for New York but not all of them, reads out that the New York games are the 13th, 16th, 22nd, 25th, 27th and 30th of June and July 5th, that July 19th is the World Cup final in New York City and it will be on CBS, that there are a lot of games and the last is July 19th, and that there are 78 games in all.
mentions.quote: July 19th is the World Cup final in New York City
mentions.falsify_match: An incident at one of the named fixtures.
mentions.falsify_miss: The tournament passes without one, which is what happened. Nothing is forecast: the dates are read straight off the published fixture list, not seen. Worth recording because a later claim of foreknowledge about any of these dates would rest on this passage.

mentions.claim_text: He says it is that virus and he sees the virus, that this is what it was in June, June two years, that it is the black death and the black on the buildings, that he asked the Lord what it is and was told to come up higher, and that it is a virus and a plague.
mentions.quote: That's what it is. That's the black death
mentions.falsify_match: A plague outbreak identified as Yersinia pestis in June 2028.
mentions.falsify_miss: No outbreak. The identification arrives here: the darkness on the buildings, previously unexplained, is now named as the black death. That moves the plague to June 2028, against the fall 2027 and 350 million telling recorded from 2 July.

mentions.claim_text: He says you do not go by what the natural mind thinks but by what the Holy Spirit is telling you to do, that they are over there interceding and praying, that he knows Pastor Candace is a prayer warrior and so is Sister Billie and the others, that he does not know whether Max is with them but probably is, and that there are great prayer warriors over there.
mentions.quote: You got some great prayer prayer warriors over there
